title: Proverbs 8:28-31 — wisdom as master craftsman beside God
summary: Proverbs 8:28-31 in English: Wisdom describes God establishing the clouds, fountains of the deep, the sea's limit and the earth's foundations, with her beside Him as a master craftsman, His daily delight, rejoicing in His inhabited world and with the sons of men. 'Waters' is shown in colour.

text.text: 28 When He established the clouds above, When He strengthened the fountains of the deep,
29 When He assigned to the sea its limit, So that the waters would not transgress His command, When He marked out the foundations of the earth,
30 Then I was beside Him as a master craftsman; And I was daily His delight, Rejoicing always before Him,
31 Rejoicing in His inhabited world, And my delight was with the sons of men.
